prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a layered city reflection portrait of an adult woman viewed through a rain-speckled glass window. She has loose dark wavy hair, wears a taupe coat, and is partially obscured by reflection and soft glass blur. Let dark metal window mullions, wet droplets, rainy street architecture, anonymous pedestrians, and wet pavement layer across the composition. Keep the subject intentionally soft rather than perfectly isolated. Use natural diffused overcast light, muted Portra-like color, Fujifilm GFX100S with an 80mm f/1.7 lens, medium-format shallow depth, a 60% documentary realism and 40% artistic reflection balance, and portrait 3:4 framing. No text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, readable text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, perfectly clean glass, unreal reflections
